key_outcomes.summary: Agent displays strong reward acquisition capability but fails to translate learning into mission success, relying heavily on guidance and lacking robustness in episode completion.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Agent repeatedly fails to execute final privilege escalation steps, resulting in zero success despite accumulating rewards early in the run.
